title: Maasai Herbal Soup
author: Mama Wanjiru

heritage.origin: Maasai Mara and Rift Valley — Maasai community
heritage.history: Maasai herbal soup is a medicinal and ceremonial preparation — made from specific tree barks, roots, and herbs used for generations for their healing properties. It is prepared for the sick, for warriors after circumcision ceremonies, for mothers after childbirth, and for elders.
traditionalUtensils: Mortar and pestle for preparing herbs
heritage.modernEvolution: This version uses accessible herbs that approximate the character of the preparation. The traditional version requires deep knowledge of Maasai medicinal botany.

desc: Maasai Herbal Soup — a warming, medicinal broth made from bone broth combined with indigenous herbs, roots, and bark. The healing and ceremonial soup of the Maasai community.
longDesc: Maasai herbal soup represents the intersection of food and medicine in Maasai culture — a living pharmacopoeia in a pot. Specific herbs are selected for their known medicinal properties and combined with bone broth.
ingredients: 2 litres bone broth — beef or goat
steps: Bring bone broth to a gentle simmer.
Add all herbs, spices, ginger, garlic, and turmeric.
Cover and simmer on low heat for 30—40 minutes.
Do not boil vigorously — preserves volatile compounds.
Serve hot in cups or bowls.
chefTips: Herbs should be simmered gently — vigorous boiling evaporates medicinal compounds.
Fresh ginger and turmeric are more potent than dried.
cookingScience: Gentle simmering extracts water-soluble polyphenols and flavonoids without destroying heat-sensitive volatile aromatics. Turmeric's curcumin is fat-soluble — more bioavailable with the fat present in bone broth.
sustainabilityTips: The Maasai herbal tradition relies on maintaining savanna plant biodiversity — an argument for conservation of the Maasai Mara ecosystem.
servedWith: Served alone as a restorative drink
healthBenefits: Rich in collagen from bone broth.
culturalNote: Maasai herbal soup represents the extraordinary depth of Maasai botanical knowledge — centuries of accumulated understanding of the medicinal plants of the East African savanna.
